name: svg-french-press-claude-opus-5.5-s1-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="900" height="1520" viewBox="0 0 900 1520" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a9097"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#eef1f4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7d838a"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfe6f2" stop-opacity=".7"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity=".4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a9cde0" stop-opacity=".7"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="black" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#222"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#666"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1a1a1a"/></linearGradient>
  <pattern id="mesh" width="5" height="5" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L5 5M5 0L0 5" stroke="#666" stroke-width=".5"/></pattern>
</defs>
<rect width="900" height="1520" fill="#fafaf7"/>
<text x="450" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="bold">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>
<text x="450" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#555">Standard three-piece plunger filter</text>

<!-- center axis -->
<line x1="330" y1="80" x2="330" y2="1490" stroke="#999" stroke-dasharray="10 4 2 4" stroke-width="1"/>

<!-- 1 knob -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <rect x="324" y="122" width="12" height="10" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="105" rx="22" ry="20" fill="url(#black)"/>
</g>
<!-- 2 lid -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <path d="M220 200 Q230 160 330 155 Q430 160 440 200 Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <rect x="215" y="200" width="230" height="10" rx="3" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <rect x="235" y="210" width="190" height="16" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="155" rx="10" ry="3" fill="#333"/>
  <path d="M235 218 h190" stroke="#666" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="425" y="210" width="14" height="10" fill="#555"/>
</g>
<!-- 3 rod -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <rect x="325" y="250" width="10" height="290" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <path d="M325 250 h10" />
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1">
    <path d="M325 254 l10 3M325 260 l10 3M325 266 l10 3"/>
    <path d="M325 524 l10 3M325 530 l10 3M325 536 l10 3"/>
  </g>
</g>
<!-- 4 cross plate -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="592" rx="124" ry="25" fill="none" stroke-width="6" stroke="#666"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="592" rx="124" ry="25" fill="none"/>
  <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M210 592 H450"/><path d="M330 568 V616"/><path d="M245 575 L415 609"/><path d="M245 609 L415 575"/></g>
  <g stroke="#ddd" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M210 591 H450"/><path d="M330 568 V616"/><path d="M245 574 L415 608"/><path d="M245 608 L415 574"/></g>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="592" rx="16" ry="6" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="592" rx="5" ry="2" fill="#222"/>
</g>
<!-- 5 mesh screen -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="670" rx="132" ry="27" fill="url(#mesh)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="670" rx="132" ry="27" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="670" rx="132" ry="27" fill="none"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="670" rx="10" ry="4" fill="#fafaf7"/>
</g>
<!-- 6 bottom plate -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="749" rx="118" ry="24" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="745" rx="118" ry="24" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="746" rx="126" ry="27" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
  <g fill="#555" stroke="none">
    <ellipse cx="270" cy="740" rx="9" ry="3"/><ellipse cx="300" cy="755" rx="9" ry="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="365" cy="735" rx="9" ry="3"/><ellipse cx="390" cy="752" rx="9" ry="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="315" cy="730" rx="9" ry="3"/><ellipse cx="410" cy="738" rx="9" ry="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="245" cy="752" rx="9" ry="3"/><ellipse cx="355" cy="760" rx="9" ry="3"/>
  </g>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="745" rx="14" ry="5" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="745" rx="5" ry="2" fill="#222"/>
</g>
<!-- 7 nut -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <path d="M316 800 h28 v14 h-28 z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <path d="M325 800 v14 M335 800 v14" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="800" rx="14" ry="4" fill="#ccc"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="800" rx="5" ry="1.8" fill="#222"/>
</g>
<!-- 8 glass beaker -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <path d="M186 878 Q196 864 216 866 L212 880 Z" fill="url(#glass)"/><path d="M210 880 L210 1150 Q210 1165 225 1165 L435 1165 Q450 1165 450 1150 L450 880" fill="url(#glass)"/>
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="880" rx="120" ry="14" fill="none"/>
  
  <ellipse cx="330" cy="1163" rx="118" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#7fa8bd" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M230 900 v240" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="6" opacity=".7"/>
  <g stroke="#7fa8bd" stroke-width="1">
    <path d="M420 960 h18M425 1000 h13M420 1040 h18M425 1080 h13"/>
  </g>
</g>
<!-- 9 frame with handle (shown offset left, same axis) -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <!-- drawn behind beaker position, outline only, at bottom -->
</g>
<!-- frame: separate, below -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" transform="translate(0,0)">
</g>

<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
  <path d="M205 1215 h20 v240 h-20 z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <path d="M435 1215 h20 v240 h-20 z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <path d="M205 1220 h250 v10 h-250 z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <path d="M200 1440 h260 v25 q0 10 -10 10 h-240 q-10 0 -10 -10 z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
  <ellipse cx="216" cy="1475" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#333"/><ellipse cx="444" cy="1475" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#333"/>
  <path d="M455 1240 C530 1240 530 1250 530 1300 L530 1400 C530 1420 510 1425 455 1425 L455 1400 C500 1400 505 1395 505 1385 L505 1290 C505 1270 500 1265 455 1265 Z" fill="url(#black)"/>
</g>
<path d="M530 1340 H600" stroke="#333" fill="none"/><circle cx="600" cy="1340" r="2" fill="#333"/>
<text x="610" y="1345" font-size="15"><tspan font-weight="bold">9</tspan>  Frame / holder with handle</text>
<path d="M330 1170 v35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="none"/>
<path d="M324 1197 l6 8 l6 -8" fill="none" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<!-- leader lines and labels -->
<g font-size="15" fill="#111">
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
    <path d="M352 105 H600"/><path d="M445 190 H600"/><path d="M335 400 H600"/>
    <path d="M454 592 H600"/><path d="M462 670 H600"/><path d="M456 745 H600"/>
    <path d="M344 807 H600"/><path d="M450 1000 H600"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#333"><circle cx="600" cy="105" r="2"/><circle cx="600" cy="190" r="2"/><circle cx="600" cy="400" r="2"/><circle cx="600" cy="592" r="2"/><circle cx="600" cy="670" r="2"/><circle cx="600" cy="745" r="2"/><circle cx="600" cy="807" r="2"/><circle cx="600" cy="1000" r="2"/></g>
  <text x="610" y="110"><tspan font-weight="bold">1</tspan>  Knob</text>
  <text x="610" y="186"><tspan font-weight="bold">2</tspan>  Lid with pour-spout</text><text x="628" y="204" font-size="12" fill="#555">strainer slot</text>
  <text x="610" y="405"><tspan font-weight="bold">3</tspan>  Plunger rod (threaded ends)</text>
  <text x="610" y="588"><tspan font-weight="bold">4</tspan>  Cross plate (top)</text><text x="628" y="606" font-size="12" fill="#555">filter piece 1 of 3</text>
  <text x="610" y="666"><tspan font-weight="bold">5</tspan>  Mesh filter screen</text><text x="628" y="684" font-size="12" fill="#555">filter piece 2 of 3 · fine stainless mesh</text>
  <text x="610" y="741"><tspan font-weight="bold">6</tspan>  Spiral plate (bottom)</text><text x="628" y="759" font-size="12" fill="#555">filter piece 3 of 3 · coil-spring rim seals glass</text>
  <text x="610" y="812"><tspan font-weight="bold">7</tspan>  Retaining nut</text>
  <text x="610" y="996"><tspan font-weight="bold">8</tspan>  Glass beaker (carafe)</text><text x="628" y="1014" font-size="12" fill="#555">with pour spout</text>
</g>
<rect x="590" y="555" width="290" height="240" fill="none" stroke="#b33" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
<text x="870" y="788" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="#b33">plunger filter assembly</text>
</svg>
